findings.expected: Each occupied part resolves the same POI entity and makes its accepted clue/content/actions available; multiple owners need an owner selection action. Terrain location may stay distinct from the selected entity.
findings.actual: Both summaries correctly contain detail-poi:1 / poi:1:2,0, but selectedHex changes from2,0 to3,0. The real knavePanel contains OWNER-ONE-CLUE at12,0 and has no POI text at18,0. findings.title: Active v11 layer with live POI owners accepts deletion of all footprints
repro: Export the valid active one-POI map from agent-work/evidence/review-HX-BL-051-a4e8a48/hx-review-repro.mjs.
Set only map.physicalGrid.poiFootprints=[]; retain active=true and the existing poiIdentities/live POI.
findings.expected: An active DETAIL1 document must cover every live owner. Reject missing coverage before map/history writes; legacy documents with no physicalGrid remain separately supported. If an intermediate identity-only checkpoint is supported, distinguish it as unadapted rather than treating it as an active displayed layer.
findings.actual: Import reports no alert, commits one transaction and accepts active=true with one live identity and zero footprints. Summary now reports zero POIs; active map renderer suppresses legacy markers and renders only footprints, so the POI disappears from the map layer. Exact Undo restores the accepted document; no claim that source POI text is erased.
findings.cause: validateDetail1Document invokes the full live spatial/coverage validator only when poiFootprints.length>0. An empty array bypasses the very incomplete_footprint_coverage check that rejects a partially missing layer.
findings.compatibility_note: Existing saveSafety and regionEditing tests intentionally accept identity-only checkpoints; this explains the hole but does not satisfy the approved active full-coverage contract. Fix should preserve legitimate legacy/unadapted states through an explicit state boundary and update those tests accordingly.
